name: volume_inter_slab_eq_signed_sum
summary: Sorting each column ν(·, j) of a point turns the cyclic interlacing conditions into a product over the letters of interlacing-indicator determinants, which expand (Leibniz) into a signed sum over tuples σ of permutations of indicators of the sets S(σ, 1, univ). Integrating this pointwise identity, each set is the image of a part of the slab under an invertible linear map, whose determinant is a constant times det(1 − q⁻¹·(Πσ)*); regrouping the tuples by their product τ gives the formula.

    (prodCongrLeft τ)).toLin').det⁻¹| * volume (Y ∩ slab k D) := by
    erw [← measure_inter_conull (ae_all_iff.2 (Measure.ae_eval_ne _ · 0)) (s := Y ∩ _), ←
      Measure.addHaar_preimage_linearMap _ (by simp [z])]
